A.source: O5 tcp_ta / O4 resp / O5 stage_tex, s_base

B.source: O5 tcp_ta + O4 resp, s_point vs s_base

criteria.arm_A: aggregate work counters (TA_BUSY, SQ_PS INSTS_TEX_LOAD) within +-2 % of the historical baseline; GPUBusyCycles within +-5 %. Work counters are exact, timing is not.
criteria.arm_B: delta(s_point vs s_base) must keep its sign and land within max(1.0 percentage point, 50 % of the historical effect) of the historical delta, on TA_BUSY and GPUBusyCycles.
criteria.arm_C: delta(L32 vs L128) must keep its sign and land within 5 percentage points of the historical delta on TA_BUSY, GPUBusyCycles and the texture instruction dose; and the implied marginal cost must stay inside O6's preregistered [10, 19] cycles band.
criteria.statistic: 32 samples per run, 3 independent processes per variant per set, order interleaved then reversed then interleaved, exactly as in O4/O6.
criteria.verdict: CLEAN_REPLICATION = PASS only if all three arms meet their criterion. Old and new measurements are never pooled; a divergence is investigated, not averaged away.
criteria.environment: verified idle before measuring: no browser, no Discord, no game, no encoder; total GPU utilisation 1.69 % (desktop compositor only), live CPU under 0.5 %.
